title: Gryd Lock Evaluation Result
description: Schema for the result document that grydlock-research must produce when evaluating a testkit fixture release. Every evaluation run must identify its dataset, implementation, and mapping versions so results can be compared across runs without ambiguity.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result schema (semver). Must match the manifestVersion in the evaluation-manifest.json used for this run.

fixtureRelease.description: The grydlock-testkit release tag evaluated (semver). Must match evaluation-manifest.json fixtureRelease.

sourceCommit.description: Full SHA-1 git commit of grydlock-testkit at evaluation time. Must match evaluation-manifest.json sourceCommit.

evaluatedAt.description: ISO-8601 datetime when this evaluation run was performed.

evaluatorVersion.description: Version of grydlock-research that produced this result (semver).

mappingVersion.description: Version of the score-to-tier mapping used (semver). Must match evaluation-manifest.json mappingVersion. Bump this whenever tier threshold boundaries change.

tierThresholds.description: The exact tier threshold configuration applied during scoring. Copied from evaluation-manifest.json so the result is self-contained.

summary.description: Aggregate accuracy metrics across the full dataset.

total.description: Total number of destinations evaluated. Must match expectedCounts.total in the manifest.

correct.description: Number of destinations where the assigned tier matched the label.

accuracy.description: Fraction of correct tier assignments (correct / total). Range [0, 1].

byLabel.description: Per-label breakdown of evaluation counts and accuracy.

perDestination.description: One entry per evaluated destination, ordered by destination ID.

total.description: Number of destinations with this label.

assignedTier.description: Tier computed by applying tierThresholds to score.

notes.description: Optional free-text annotation for this result (e.g. edge-case explanation).
